### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* sign releases with Morphe signing key ([c65a0ee](https://github.com/sircoderin/morphe-patches/commit/c65a0ee0c9241f175e0c88deca7557e403466e05))

patches.name: Instant search dismiss
patches.description: Closes the search overlay as soon as the swipe-to-close is released, instead of after the swipe animation fully settles (removes the frozen blur when closing).

patches.name: Search fade-in
patches.description: Fades and gently scales the search overlay in when it opens, mirroring the close animation.
